body.title: fix(engine): override htpasswd to support optional hash algorithm parameter
body.body:
Replay of `https://github.com/helm/helm/pull/32745` for triage testing.

## Summary

Fixes issue `#31924`: The `htpasswd` template function does not expose the algorithm parameter.

### Root Cause

Helm currently depends on **sprig v3.3.0**, whose `htpasswd` function only accepts **2 arguments** (`username`, `password`) and always uses bcrypt. However, newer sprig versions (master branch) accept an **optional 3rd argument** for specifying the hash algorithm (`bcrypt` default or `sha`).

### Fix

Override sprig's `htpasswd` in Helm's `funcMap()` with a custom Go variadic function that accepts both 2-arg and 3-arg calls:

- `htpasswd "user" "password"` - bcrypt (backward compatible)
- `htpasswd "user" "password" "bcrypt"` - explicit bcrypt  
- `htpasswd "user" "password" "sha"` - SHA-1 with `{SHA}` prefix

The SHA-1 output follows the standard htpasswd convention: `username:{SHA}<base64-encoded-sha1>`.

### Changes

**`pkg/engine/funcs.go`**:
- Added `crypto/sha1`, `encoding/base64`, and `golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt` imports
- Override `"htpasswd"` in the template `FuncMap` with a custom implementation
- New variadic `htpasswd(username, password, ...algorithm)` function supporting `bcrypt` (default) and `sha` algorithms

### Backward Compatibility

The 2-argument form continues to work as before, always using bcrypt.

---

Fixes `#31924`

Signed-off-by: yancy <yancy@users.noreply.github.com>

body.patch:
@@ -18,6 +18,8 @@ package engine
 
 import (
 	"bytes"
+	"crypto/sha1"
+	"encoding/base64"
 	"encoding/json"
 	"errors"
 	"fmt"
@@ -31,6 +33,7 @@ import (
 
 	"github.com/BurntSushi/toml"
 	"github.com/Masterminds/sprig/v3"
+	"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"
 	"sigs.k8s.io/yaml"
 	goYaml "sigs.k8s.io/yaml/goyaml.v3"
 )
@@ -92,6 +95,12 @@ func funcMap() template.FuncMap {
 		"lookup": func(string, string, string, string) (map[string]any, error) {
 			return map[string]any{}, nil
 		},
+
+		// Override sprig's htpasswd to support optional algorithm parameter.
+		// sprig v3.3.0 only accepts 2 args; this override accepts an optional 3rd arg
+		// for hash algorithm ("bcrypt" default or "sha").
+		// See: https://github.com/helm/helm/issues/31924
+		"htpasswd": htpasswd,
 	}
 
 	maps.Copy(f, extra)
@@ -474,3 +483,42 @@ func durationTruncateTo(v, m any) time.Duration {
 	}
 	return d.Truncate(mul)
 }
+
+// htpasswd generates an htpasswd-formatted password hash.
+//
+// This overrides sprig's htpasswd function (which in sprig v3.3.0 only accepts
+// 2 arguments) to support an optional third argument for specifying the hash algorithm.
+//
+// Usage in templates:
+//
+//	htpasswd "user" "password"            // defaults to bcrypt (backward compatible)
+//	htpasswd "user" "password" "bcrypt"   // explicit bcrypt
+//	htpasswd "user" "password" "sha"      // SHA-1 hex digest with {SHA} prefix
+//
+// Returns: "username:hashed_password" or an error string on failure.
+//
+// See: https://github.com/helm/helm/issues/31924
+func htpasswd(username, password string, algorithm ...string) string {
+	if strings.Contains(username, ":") {
+		return fmt.Sprintf("invalid username: %s", username)
+	}
+
+	algo := "bcrypt"
+	if len(algorithm) > 0 {
+		algo = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(algorithm[0]))
+	}
+
+	switch algo {
+	case "sha", "sha1":
+		sum := sha1.Sum([]byte(password))
+		return fmt.Sprintf("%s:{SHA}%s", username, base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(sum[:]))
+	case "bcrypt":
+		hash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
+		if err != nil {
+			return fmt.Sprintf("failed to encrypt string with bcrypt: %s", err)
+		}
+		return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", username, string(hash))
+	default:
+		return fmt.Sprintf("unsupported hash algorithm: %s (supported: bcrypt, sha)", algo)
+	}
+}

commit.message:
fix(engine): override htpasswd to support optional hash algorithm parameter

The sprig v3.3.0 htpasswd function only accepts 2 arguments
(username, password), but newer sprig versions (master branch) accept
an optional 3rd argument for specifying the hash algorithm
("bcrypt" default or "sha").

This change overrides sprig htpasswd in the FuncMap with a Go
variadic-function that accepts both 2-arg and 3-arg calls:

  htpasswd "user" "password"            # bcrypt (backward compatible)
  htpasswd "user" "password" "bcrypt"   # explicit bcrypt
  htpasswd "user" "password" "sha"      # SHA-1 with {SHA} prefix

Fixes: https://github.com/helm/helm/issues/31924
Signed-off-by: yancy <yancy@users.noreply.github.com>
